entries.speaker: aldric
entries.shown: [echoing] "There is something else I should have told you both. Hiwot is also Morrak’s child. A Warden brought her to Lanternhold after the same raid. I raised you together because neither of you should have had to face this alone.
entries.text: [echoing] "There is something else I should have told you both. Hiwot is also Morrak’s child. A Warden brought her to Lanternhold after the same raid. I raised you together because neither of you should have had to face this alone.

entries.speaker: aldric
entries.shown: [echoing] If one of you dies, the power in your blood returns to Morrak’s realm. His priests know how to bind a soul to it. Keep each other away from their altars."
entries.text: [echoing] If one of you dies, the power in your blood returns to Morrak’s realm. His priests know how to bind a soul to it. Keep each other away from their altars."

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [controlled] The Council has your evidence. My claim to the city is finished, and the war I prepared will not happen. You have cost me an army and years of work.
entries.text: [controlled] The Council has your evidence. My claim to the city is finished, and the war I prepared will not happen. You have cost me an army and years of work.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] You have not stopped the succession. Morrak left part of his power in each of his children. I have taken it from those I killed. Baba taught me how to use it.
entries.text: [cold] You have not stopped the succession. Morrak left part of his power in each of his children. I have taken it from those I killed. Baba taught me how to use it.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] I killed him. He knew what I wanted, and he stood between us. He chose to die protecting you. I went there prepared to kill him.
entries.text: [hard] I killed him. He knew what I wanted, and he stood between us. He chose to die protecting you. I went there prepared to kill him.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] The Council would keep me in chains until it could decide how to execute me. You may prefer that. I do not.
entries.text: [cold] The Council would keep me in chains until it could decide how to execute me. You may prefer that. I do not.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] Then ask. You have read enough of my correspondence to deserve an answer from me.
entries.text: [measured] Then ask. You have read enough of my correspondence to deserve an answer from me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] My couriers brought reports from the roads, the mines and the city. I know how you reached me.
entries.text: [measured] My couriers brought reports from the roads, the mines and the city. I know how you reached me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [quiet] Amara is dead. She went there to bargain for my life, and you killed her. Tell me again how far you are willing to go for someone you love.
entries.text: [quiet] Amara is dead. She went there to bargain for my life, and you killed her. Tell me again how far you are willing to go for someone you love.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] Amara. I asked you to hold the gate. Now you stand beside the person who means to kill me.
entries.text: [hard] Amara. I asked you to hold the gate. Now you stand beside the person who means to kill me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [quiet] You let Amara live. I had expected you to kill anyone I put between us.
entries.text: [quiet] You let Amara live. I had expected you to kill anyone I put between us.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] Folake offered you information. You killed her. My guards reported what happened on her floor.
entries.text: [cold] Folake offered you information. You killed her. My guards reported what happened on her floor.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] You had Folake arrested. She knew enough to ruin me, and you kept her alive to give evidence. That was a costly loss.
entries.text: [measured] You had Folake arrested. She knew enough to ruin me, and you kept her alive to give evidence. That was a costly loss.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [dry] Folake offered you my death in return for the Consortium. One of her servants brought me the terms. She always did know what she wanted.
entries.text: [dry] Folake offered you my death in return for the Consortium. One of her servants brought me the terms. She always did know what she wanted.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] You reached an agreement with the druids. They let you through their wood. I had only enemies there.
entries.text: [measured] You reached an agreement with the druids. They let you through their wood. I had only enemies there.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] You drove the druids from the path. Their elders survived. My scouts saw them withdraw into the wood.
entries.text: [measured] You drove the druids from the path. Their elders survived. My scouts saw them withdraw into the wood.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] Grukhar offered you the letters for his life. You killed him and took them. You had already been offered another way.
entries.text: [cold] Grukhar offered you the letters for his life. You killed him and took them. You had already been offered another way.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [dry] Grukhar gave you the letters, and you let him leave. A useful bargain. I doubt the miners thanked you for it.
entries.text: [dry] Grukhar gave you the letters, and you let him leave. A useful bargain. I doubt the miners thanked you for it.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] You opened the sluice while the prisoners were still below. Beau died with them. You knew they had not reached the stairs.
entries.text: [hard] You opened the sluice while the prisoners were still below. Beau died with them. You knew they had not reached the stairs.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] You held the valve room until the prisoners were clear. That cost you time and put your company at risk. You could have opened the sluice sooner.
entries.text: [measured] You held the valve room until the prisoners were clear. That cost you time and put your company at risk. You could have opened the sluice sooner.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [dismissive] Segun and his men failed to hold the stairs. I paid him well to keep you out. It seems I overestimated him.
entries.text: [dismissive] Segun and his men failed to hold the stairs. I paid him well to keep you out. It seems I overestimated him.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [insistent] You have killed people who offered you another way. You had reasons for each of them. I have reasons too. Do you believe Morrak cares which of us can defend those reasons?
entries.text: [insistent] You have killed people who offered you another way. You had reasons for each of them. I have reasons too. Do you believe Morrak cares which of us can defend those reasons?

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] You spared people I expected you to kill. Some of them helped you reach me. I misjudged what you could achieve that way.
entries.text: [measured] You spared people I expected you to kill. Some of them helped you reach me. I misjudged what you could achieve that way.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] You are responsible for your choices. I am responsible for mine. I will not pretend otherwise.
entries.text: [cold] You are responsible for your choices. I am responsible for mine. I will not pretend otherwise.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] Regret will not bring them back. You still have to decide what to do with me.
entries.text: [cold] Regret will not bring them back. You still have to decide what to do with me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] I do. I thought mercy would make you easier to stop. I was wrong.
entries.text: [measured] I do. I thought mercy would make you easier to stop. I was wrong.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [steady] You wanted answers. What else do you need to know?
entries.text: [steady] You wanted answers. What else do you need to know?

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] Baba Olusegun brought me the temple records. He found my mother’s name and traced what happened to her child. Adigun had paid him to educate me. He gave me considerably more than my father intended.
entries.text: [measured] Baba Olusegun brought me the temple records. He found my mother’s name and traced what happened to her child. Adigun had paid him to educate me. He gave me considerably more than my father intended.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] At first I had only his word and the records. Then he found another of Morrak’s children. I killed the man and felt his power pass into me. After that, I paid for the searches myself.
entries.text: [cold] At first I had only his word and the records. Then he found another of Morrak’s children. I killed the man and felt his power pass into me. After that, I paid for the searches myself.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [controlled] Morrak’s priests had gathered children for a sacrifice. They believed our deaths could restore him. Tesfaye and the Wardens attacked before they could finish. He found you alive. He counted me among the dead.
entries.text: [controlled] Morrak’s priests had gathered children for a sacrifice. They believed our deaths could restore him. Tesfaye and the Wardens attacked before they could finish. He found you alive. He counted me among the dead.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [bitter] Someone came back through the chapel afterwards and found me breathing. I survived. In time, Adigun took me into his house. I knew none of this until Baba found the reports.
entries.text: [bitter] Someone came back through the chapel afterwards and found me breathing. I survived. In time, Adigun took me into his house. I knew none of this until Baba found the reports.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [strained] That is what his report says. I have read it many times. He believed I was dead. He was wrong. He left, and he never came back.
entries.text: [strained] That is what his report says. I have read it many times. He believed I was dead. He was wrong. He left, and he never came back.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] No, surviving gave me no right to murder him. I wanted you dead, and he would not let me have you. That was the choice I made.
entries.text: [hard] No, surviving gave me no right to murder him. I wanted you dead, and he would not let me have you. That was the choice I made.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] Adigun paid for the ruined ore and the bandits. He wanted the city frightened enough to pay his prices. A war would have closed his trade routes. When he learned I was buying votes to send the army into Calder, he tried to stop me.
entries.text: [measured] Adigun paid for the ruined ore and the bandits. He wanted the city frightened enough to pay his prices. A war would have closed his trade routes. When he learned I was buying votes to send the army into Calder, he tried to stop me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] By then, his couriers were taking my orders. They carried payments to the men hunting our kin. He did not understand what I was doing until he found the death notices.
entries.text: [cold] By then, his couriers were taking my orders. They carried payments to the men hunting our kin. He did not understand what I was doing until he found the death notices.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] I sent you to his meeting and arranged the witnesses. You killed him. My men told the guards what they had seen, and I accused you. With him dead and you in custody, I could take control of the Consortium.
entries.text: [measured] I sent you to his meeting and arranged the witnesses. You killed him. My men told the guards what they had seen, and I accused you. With him dead and you in custody, I could take control of the Consortium.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] You refused to kill him. I could not let him leave that room alive, so I killed him myself. Then I called the guards. My men supported my accusation, and you were standing beside his body.
entries.text: [measured] You refused to kill him. I could not let him leave that room alive, so I killed him myself. Then I called the guards. My men supported my accusation, and you were standing beside his body.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] I arranged the meeting, the witnesses and the guards. Adigun died, you went to prison, and I took control of the Consortium.
entries.text: [measured] I arranged the meeting, the witnesses and the guards. Adigun died, you went to prison, and I took control of the Consortium.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [measured] The war would have given me enough power to claim Morrak’s realm outright. Without it, I need another divine soul to force a passage. Once inside, I can bind the power still held there.
entries.text: [measured] The war would have given me enough power to claim Morrak’s realm outright. Without it, I need another divine soul to force a passage. Once inside, I can bind the power still held there.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] It will take time. That is why I intend to kill you before you can follow me.
entries.text: [cold] It will take time. That is why I intend to kill you before you can follow me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] Hiwot carries the same blood. Tesfaye raised two of Morrak’s children at Lanternhold. Baba found her name beside yours. His rite can bind her soul even after death.
entries.text: [cold] Hiwot carries the same blood. Tesfaye raised two of Morrak’s children at Lanternhold. Baba found her name beside yours. His rite can bind her soul even after death.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [firm] Get up, Amara. I know what you are offering. I will not spend the rest of my life in that cell.
entries.text: [firm] Get up, Amara. I know what you are offering. I will not spend the rest of my life in that cell.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] I have answered you. Now decide what you came here to do.
entries.text: [hard] I have answered you. Now decide what you came here to do.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] Then fight me. I will not ask you to forgive me.
entries.text: [hard] Then fight me. I will not ask you to forgive me.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] You understand what I have done to reach this point, and you still want to continue it. Very well. You will have to kill me first.
entries.text: [cold] You understand what I have done to reach this point, and you still want to continue it. Very well. You will have to kill me first.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] While you followed me down here, my remaining guards went to the inn. They brought Hiwot through the servants’ passage. She is behind the altar.
entries.text: [cold] While you followed me down here, my remaining guards went to the inn. They brought Hiwot through the servants’ passage. She is behind the altar.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] My remaining guards found Hiwot before you reached the temple. They brought her through the servants’ passage. She is behind the altar.
entries.text: [cold] My remaining guards found Hiwot before you reached the temple. They brought her through the servants’ passage. She is behind the altar.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [cold] Hiwot’s soul has already returned to our father’s realm. Baba bound it to this altar. I did not need to find her alive.
entries.text: [cold] Hiwot’s soul has already returned to our father’s realm. Baba bound it to this altar. I did not need to find her alive.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [breathless] You broke my army. You have beaten me here. But you brought the rite within reach.
entries.text: [breathless] You broke my army. You have beaten me here. But you brought the rite within reach.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [strained] The passage is open. By the time you reach me, I will have bound the throne.
entries.text: [strained] The passage is open. By the time you reach me, I will have bound the throne.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [furious] You followed me. Before the binding was complete.
entries.text: [furious] You followed me. Before the binding was complete.

entries.speaker: korvath
entries.shown: [hard] Then I will finish this myself. Your soul will join hers.
entries.text: [hard] Then I will finish this myself. Your soul will join hers.

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [urgent] The marks on the floor! They lead to the altar. Get away from them!
entries.text: [urgent] The marks on the floor! They lead to the altar. Get away from them!

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [shocked] No. Let go of me!
entries.text: [shocked] No. Let go of me!

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [weak] I can hear you. He has bound me to the throne. Break his hold before he can finish.
entries.text: [weak] I can hear you. He has bound me to the throne. Break his hold before he can finish.

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [quiet] He’s gone. I can feel the power he took, and yours. It is holding this place open.
entries.text: [quiet] He’s gone. I can feel the power he took, and yours. It is holding this place open.

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [steady] If you let it all go, I can come back with you. You will lose Morrak’s blood, and any claim to his throne. If you keep it, you can take his place. I cannot come back that way.
entries.text: [steady] If you let it all go, I can come back with you. You will lose Morrak’s blood, and any claim to his throne. If you keep it, you can take his place. I cannot come back that way.

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [unsteady] I can breathe. I thought I would never...
entries.text: [unsteady] I can breathe. I thought I would never...

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [soft] You came back for me. Let’s get out of here. Please.
entries.text: [soft] You came back for me. Let’s get out of here. Please.

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [quiet] I wanted to go home with you. I hope you remember that.
entries.text: [quiet] I wanted to go home with you. I hope you remember that.

entries.speaker: ambrose
entries.shown: [quiet] Tesfaye began this letter when he brought you here. He added to it before you left. He asked me to keep it safe until you were ready to know.
entries.text: [quiet] Tesfaye began this letter when he brought you here. He added to it before you left. He asked me to keep it safe until you were ready to know.
entries.before: [quiet] Tesfaye wrote it the year he brought you here. He made me swear to give it to you only when someone had already tried to tell you the wrong way.
